```plato
    // IOrderable primitive; LessThan / GreaterThan / GreaterThanOrEquals /
    // Compare / Clamp / Lesser / Greater all derive from it in

    LessThanOrEquals(a: Number, b: Number): Boolean;
```

```plato
    //==
    // Character and String
    //
    // Both primitives declare `IOrderable` (primitives.plato), which the host must
    // discharge: String order is ordinal in every runtime (UTF-16 code units in C#
    // and the interpreter, bytes in the C++ prelude; the same for ASCII), never the
    // platform's culture collation: "B" < "a", and a prefix precedes its extension.
    // Operator-named, so the C# writer synthesizes the wrapper from the runtime's
    // comparison operators.

    LessThanOrEquals(a: Character, b: Character): Boolean;
```
